commentsViewMode.note: One family with `GET /v1/presentations/{}?commentsViewMode` and `GET /v4/spreadsheets/{}?commentsViewMode`, all three marked Developer Preview. Google's own description (Docs): "The comments view mode to apply to the document. This allows viewing the document with comments omitted or included. If one is not specified, COMMENTS_VIEW_MODE_OMITTED is used." Backlot declares it on Sheets alone (`routers.google_sheets._sheets_comments_view`). Measured against the three hosts on 2026-09-29 with a user token: Sheets and Slides answer each of the four enum values 200, and `comments_view_mode_omitted` in lower case as well, and refuse `BOGUS` and the empty value with 400 `Invalid value at 'comments_view_mode' (type.googleapis.com/google.apps.sheets.v4.CommentsViewMode), "BOGUS"` (`google.apps.slides.v1` on Slides). Docs refuses those two the same way under `google.apps.docs.v1` and answers `COMMENTS_VIEW_MODE_UNSPECIFIED` 200, but refuses the other three with 400 `Comments view mode may only be specified if tabs content is also requested.` unless `includeTabsContent=true` or a `fields` mask naming `tabs` comes with them. With tabs requested, `COMMENTS_VIEW_MODE_INCLUDED` is refused with `Comments may only be explicitly included if inline suggestions are also explicitly requested.` until `suggestionsViewMode=SUGGESTIONS_INLINE` joins it, and `COMMENTS_VIEW_MODE_DEFAULT_FOR_CURRENT_ACCESS` beside `suggestionsViewMode=PREVIEW_WITHOUT_SUGGESTIONS` with `Comments may not be requested when previewing suggestions.` Those two Docs parameters are gaps in this file as well: this server reads neither, so the rules that tie them to this one have nothing to act on.
Same family as `GET /v1/documents/{}?commentsViewMode`, whose note carries the measurement on all three hosts.
